construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit H23-035 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2023), status Approved, issue date 2025-02-11: "Site Development Permit to convert approximately 22,051 square feet of existing upper level commercial space into 16 new multifamily residential units (including 10 live/work units) at an existing mixed-use residential building. There are no proposed chan" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

The conversion is inside Vespaio, a seven-story mixed-use building built under PD16-006 (Hudson Companies, approved 2016: 164 units and at least 37,500 sf commercial). City GIS PRE23-070 describes converting part of the first-floor commercial space into a leasing office and second- and third-floor commercial space; H23-035 converts about 22,051 sf of upper-level commercial space into 16 units including 10 live/work units.

RENTV (2023-07-06): Windy Hill Property Ventures and Rockwood Capital joint venture bought Vespaio, 162 units on 1.72 acres built in 2020, from Hudson Companies for $83.5 million ($515k per unit); Cushman & Wakefield represented the seller and arranged acquisition debt. Windy Hill's investments page lists Vespaio as 162 units and about 10,000 sf retail.
